name: Wing Tai Properties Limited
summary: Wing Tai Properties Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the investment, development, and management of properties in Hong Kong, the United Kingdom, the People's Republic of China, Singapore, and internationally. It operates through Property Development; Property Investment and Management; Hospitality Investment and Management; and Others segments. The company's investment properties include commercial, industrial, residential units and serviced apartments, and hotel projects. It is also involved in hospitality management, treasury investment, and licensing. The company was formerly known as USI Holdings Limited and changed its name to Wing Tai Properties Limited in June 2010. …
